## FAQ

Explore essential FAQs on bulk tote bag orders, logo printing, eco-materials, delivery timelines, and MOQ from top tote bag wholesalers in India.

Why should I buy tote bags in bulk?

Buying in bulk helps reduce the cost per unit, ensures brand consistency, and allows for large-scale distribution for retail, events, or promotions.

What materials do you use for your wholesale tote bags?

As trusted **Tote Bag Wholesalers in India**, we offer eco-friendly tote bags made from ethically sourced cotton, jute, and canvas—designed for durability and daily use.

Can I customize my wholesale tote bags with a logo?

Yes! As one of the leading **Tote Bag Wholesalers in India**, we provide full customization services including logo printing, brand colors, sizes, and design layouts to match your needs.

Is there a minimum order quantity for wholesale tote bags?

Our minimum order typically starts at 100 pieces, but we accommodate flexible volumes depending on the design and type of tote bag.

How long does it take to fulfill a bulk order?

Standard turnaround time is 7–15 business days, depending on the order size and customization. We also offer priority production for urgent orders.

Do you ship across India and internationally?

Yes, we deliver pan-India and support international shipping as well. All orders are securely packed and tracked for timely delivery.

What types of tote bags do you offer for wholesale?

We manufacture plain tote bags, printed totes, promotional totes, shopping totes, and premium eco-friendly totes to suit different business and personal requirements.

As one of the top tote bag wholesalers in India, Double R Bags ensures affordable pricing, high-quality materials, bulk production capacity, eco-friendly designs, and nationwide delivery.
